focus: RoFormer / Rotary Position Embedding, Section 3.2 (2-D case). Explain that a 2-D query/key vector at position m is rotated by angle m*theta, and that the dot product of the rotated query at position m and key at position n depends only on the relative offset m-n. Let the learner edit the 2-D query and key vectors, theta, and the positions m and n; draw the vectors before and after rotation and show the dot product. Check that shifting m and n by the same amount leaves the dot product unchanged.
